Schaefferia emucronata from Stourton, Wiltshire, England, United Kingdom.

Original description on Flickr:

Well, this one seems straightforward at least- I spent the day at Stourhead in the woods, though the weather was rotten- crazily windy and wet, so no relaxed hunting in the sun for me. Found a few interesting things though...
